definitions.depth_finite_nonzero_fraction: finite and != 0 pixels / all decoded pixels; negative pixels counted separately
definitions.gripper_feedback_valid: finite position 0..100, active=1, fault=0, fault_id=0, motiondone in {1,2,3}, speed=0; not grasp-success evidence
definitions.robot_minus_camera_s: robot.received_monotonic minus camera.source_timestamp_monotonic, host timestamps; not an exposure-time guarantee
definitions.depth_integrity_scope: wire compressed payload SHA and materialized/reconstructed float32 source SHA are separate; does not prove native Y16 retention or pixel correspondence
definitions.rgb_integrity_scope: JPEG bytes checked against wire SHA and wire payload; original pre-JPEG RGB source SHA cannot be verified from lossy JPEG alone
definitions.physical_success_scope: source user-review verdict retained as evidence; this audit does not independently assert physical success
